auditor: Codex single assistant; CPU JSON/hash audit; no GPU and no source mutations
audit_scope: exact normalized path overlap, target-group split, shared facts and repeated target templates; not content-based independence or generalization accuracy

normalization.path_extraction: exactly one line matching ^完整路径：(.*)$ in each training input; strip outer whitespace
normalization.path_normalization: replace / with backslash; Unicode casefold; no filesystem resolution, content reads, symlink checks, dot-segment collapse, or brand-prefix fuzzy equivalence
normalization.notes: This models exact Windows path-string overlap after slash/case normalization, not semantic/contents overlap.

split.method: random.Random(42).shuffle(sorted(unique target group labels)); hold first max(1,len(groups)//10)

pip_knowledge_exposure.finding: Only pip-cache target labels/answers are held out. Pip facts occur as distractors in four OneNote training rows and pip/cache-backup names occur in four unknown training rows. It is not a pip-knowledge or software-name holdout.

target_answer_templates.text: 这是 WebView2 的运行库，桌面软件用它来显示网页界面。即使你不用 Edge 浏览器，也可能有其他应用依赖它；直接删掉会影响这些应用。建议保留，通过系统应用管理处理，别按版本号猜哪些文件可以删。
仅凭这个文件名和路径，无法确定它的具体用途，也不能保证删除后能恢复。如果要清理，先通过创建它的软件确认内容，并备份需要保留的数据。
先确认笔记已经同步并做好备份。这个 OneNote 缓存可能留着还没上传的笔记修改，直接删除会丢失这些内容，云端也未必有副本。要腾空间，先在 OneNote 中检查同步状态，再管理不再需要的笔记本。
这是 pip 下载或构建 Python 包时留下的缓存副本，和已经装好的包是分开的。清理后，现有 Python 包还能使用，只是下次安装可能需要重新下载或构建。可以用 pip cache purge 清理。

它位于当前用户的临时目录，不过路径本身不能说明这个文件里是什么。应用或安装程序可能还在使用它，贸然清理会让当前任务失败。先关闭相关任务，再用 Windows 的临时文件清理功能处理，并跳过仍被占用的文件。
这是 Windows 临时目录中的文件，系统服务或安装任务可能还在使用它。先等相关任务结束，优先通过 Windows 的存储清理功能处理。被占用的文件应跳过，别强行删除。

limitations: No exact normalized test-path overlap is evidence only of path-string separation, not independently sourced knowledge or unseen file contents.
All eight registry facts occur in training inputs, including held-out pip facts as distractors. Test RAG uses the same frozen facts registry.
168 synthesized examples reuse nine exact answer texts, including eight known-type reference templates and one uncertainty template; training150 has only eight unique target texts.

The dataset consists of synthetic username/version/path variants and context variants of eight file families; 168 rows contain only124 unique normalized paths, with110 in training and14 in validation.
Train/test instruction framing and path categories share templates; holding out a target group and avoiding test checkpoint selection do not demonstrate independent new-knowledge generalization.

This audit does not inspect physical user-file contents, creation software, near-duplicate sentence semantics, or memorizeability through pretraining. Test24 small cases remain a descriptive closed-domain evaluation.
interpretation: The family split tests behavior when the pip positive target-answer template is absent from SFT targets, with pip facts still visible as distractors and at test time through RAG. Report it as a target-group holdout, not fact-isolated or independent-knowledge generalization.
